messages:
Marta (mktg): Quick sync — release announcement for Optimize v2 tomorrow. Need final changelog lines, docs URL, and rollout timing. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/451 . Docs preview: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2-preview . Lock timing by EOD PT?

Ravi (eng): Will do. Proposed rollout: canary 09:00 PT (5%), demo pin for webinar at 10:00 PT, promote to 100% by 12:00 PT if green. Small KV cache tweak will land before canary.

Emily (docs): I updated the quickstart and added the Console screenshot. Final docs URL will be https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2 at 16:00 PT. Added a short rollback FAQ.

Priya (prod-marketing): Need benchmark sentence for hero: latency at 4k context and token cost delta. Can eng confirm numbers?

Ravi (eng): Use: "~40% median latency reduction at 4k context and ~30% token cost reduction with new batching/quantization defaults." I'll paste a short blurb into the changelog.

Marta (mktg): Good. Set alert: page #eng-oncall if error rate > 0.8% during rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Ravi at 2026-03-26T09:00:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Ravi (eng): Canary live (5%). Health checks green. Pinning demo to variant optimize-v2-demo.

Marta (mktg): Docs link confirmed, benchmark line received. We'll publish marketing at 12:15 PT. Post-rollout checklist: update changelog, confirm redirects, upload press kit.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: optimize-v2 -> 100% traffic at 2026-03-26T12:03:00-07:00.

Marta (mktg): Launch live. Thanks everyone — retro tomorrow morning.
